paragraphs.text: The Otarian Sea is the sea that lies east and south off the southern edge of the continent of Otaria . It is the location of the Mer Empire , the Aboshan Trench , and Riptide Island .

To the west of the Otarian Sea stretched the Great Ocean , while the Old Voda Sea is in the southeast. To the northwest is the Ilesemare Sea , the South Sea , despite its name, is to the north, and the Shielded Sea is the northeast, while the Deep Sea Trench lies far to the east.
